items.title: Pigeons Playing Ping Pong- Jeremy Schon & Greg Ormont interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 8, 2024
items.q: "That happens every year, Monk. We’re cursed with New Year’s balloons."

ctx.x: Well said. There was an interesting moment from a video that you were playing on a New Year’s Eve and you were playing “Auld Lang Syne.” I think you were waiting for the balloons to fall or something, and they weren’t.

Which year? That happens every year, Monk. We’re cursed with New Year’s balloons. Actually this year though I think the curse didn’t rear it’s head but man there’s been multiple, multiple times that the balloons haven’t dropped, the string breaks and now how © Fillius Jazz Archive -12-

do you even get the balloons to drop? There was one concert when we were playing a slightly smaller venue, still like a thousand people but not as, like the way that it was set up the string that you used to pull the balloon net were within the crowd and I don’t know if the security fell asleep or took a coffee break but a fan pulled it at around 11:40 PM. So needless to say we did not break into “Auld Lang Syne.” We say Happy New Year while playing music, in time, at midnight on the dot, whether the balloons are…
